meta.du_lieu: ADFECGDB (PhysioNet) 5 ban ghi x 4 kenh bung, 1000 Hz, nhan edf.qrs tu kenh Direct
meta.giao_thuc: +/-50 ms, ghep 1-1 tham lam M.match_events, macro F1 = TB F1 tung (ban ghi x kenh)
meta.front_end: M.preprocess: Butterworth bac 4 dai 10-60 Hz + notch 50 Hz, resample 250 Hz; M.detect_maternal_qrs
meta.tuning: sieu tham so chon CHI tren r01 (macro F1 4 kenh), ap nguyen cho ['r04', 'r07', 'r08', 'r10']; luoi co dinh truoc
meta.pan_tompkins: dao ham 5 diem, binh phuong, tich phan 60 ms, THR=NPK+frac*(SPK-NPK); SPK/NPK = trung vi 8 dinh gan nhat (Hamilton-Tompkins 1986) [bien the CHINH] hoac trung binh mu 1/8 (Pan-Tompkins 1985) [bien the goc, phu]; tro 250 ms; search-back 1.66*RR (RR = trung vi 8 RR hop ly 0.30-0.70 s, mac dinh 0.45 s) voi 0.5*THR; vi tri = max|res| +/-40 ms
meta.kenh_mu_nhan: pick_blind() cua benchmark_dpss/blind_lead.py (PSD dinh 1,8-3,0 Hz) ap len phan du cua chinh baseline

TS.mota: mau trung binh, tru truc tiep; Pan-Tompkins thich nghi

TS-PCA.mota: mau PCA (n_pc=2) tren nhip me; Pan-Tompkins thich nghi

Prominence.mota: phan du M.cancel_maternal (front-end cua nhom); find_peaks prominence=median+3*MAD, distance 250 ms

supp_MedLS+PT.mota: bo sung: front-end cua nhom + Pan-Tompkins (thr_frac=0.750)

supp_TS+PTexp.mota: bo sung: TS + PT bien the goc trung binh mu (thr_frac=0.625)

supp_TS-PCA+PTexp.mota: bo sung: TS-PCA + PT bien the goc trung binh mu (thr_frac=0.750)
